d:
A regal avian species with a balanced, athletic build, featuring charcoal grey plumage and a sharp, defined beak. The head is adorned with a crown of short, charcoal grey feathers and keen, intelligent golden eyes. The wings are powerful with charcoal grey feathers and the tail is a medium-length, tufted charcoal grey plume. Three sharp claws per foot and three sharp talons per wing-hand.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
